articles.title: At least 60 killed in gold mine collapse in remote area of Sudan
articles.description: A gold mine collapse on Wednesday killed at least 67 people in a remote area in Sudan, a medical group and survivors reported. The destruction occurred at the al-Zara gold mine, located in West Kordofan province – an area under the control of the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces, who have been at war with the country’s military for over three years.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran's tour in trouble after opening acts drop out in solidarity with rapper Macklemore

articles.title: EU chief calls for creation of ‘European Security Council’, backs partnership with Canada

articles.title: Les salaires vont légèrement augmenter en 2027, selon une étude

articles.title: New French ambassador to US cleared to take up post after diplomatic spat

articles.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : les dernières informations

articles.title: Middle East live: Arab League chief condemns alleged Houthi attack on Mecca

articles.title: Trump says renovation of Kennedy Center depends on whether his name is on it
